subject: general
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

His __obscure__ instructions caused confusion among the team members.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Ambiguous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Obscure**' means not clearly expressed or understood; ambiguous or vague. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example**: The reasoning behind his decision remains **obscure**.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym '**Ambiguous**' means open to more than one interpretation; unclear or inexact. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example**: The rules are **ambiguous **and open to interpretation.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is '**Ambiguous**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is** “Option 4”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Disingenuous**' means not candid or sincere, typically by pretending that one knows less about something than one really does. (कपटी)
 
• '**Disastrous**' refers to causing great damage. (विनाशकारी)
 
• '**Clear**' means easy to perceive or understand. (स्पष्ट)

145:Tab6,

ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ **'Ambiguous'** ਹੈ।
